AI.title_translation: 面向高效语音情感识别的光谱学习与注意力机制
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于1D-CNN、通道和空间注意力机制以及MFCC特征增强数据增强的语音情感识别方法，在多个数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语音情感识别（SER）方法难以捕捉细微的情感变化并在不同数据集上泛化。
AI.method: 提取梅尔频率倒谱系数（MFCC）作为光谱特征，并结合数据增强技术。利用增强数据提取的MFCC特征，通过集成通道和空间注意力机制的1D卷积神经网络（CNN）进行处理。
AI.result: 在SAVEE、RAVDESS、CREMA-D、TESS、EMO-DB和EMOVO数据集上分别达到了97.49%、99.23%、89.31%、99.82%、99.53%和96.39%的准确率，创下新的基准。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法通过集成先进的深度学习（DL）方法，显著提高了跨不同数据集的泛化能力，证明了其在辅助技术和人机交互等现实世界应用中推进SER的潜力。
AI.translation: 语音情感识别（SER）传统上依赖于对音频数据进行分析以进行情感分类。一些研究采用了不同的SER方法。然而，现有的SER方法常常难以捕捉细微的情感变化并在不同的数据集上进行泛化。在本文中，我们使用梅尔频率倒谱系数（MFCCs）作为光谱特征，以弥合计算情感处理与人类听觉感知之间的差距。为了进一步提高鲁棒性和特征多样性，我们提出了一种新颖的基于1D-CNN的SER框架，该框架集成了数据增强技术。从增强数据中提取的MFCC特征使用集成了通道和空间注意力机制的一维卷积神经网络（CNN）架构进行处理。这些注意力模块使模型能够突出关键的情感模式，从而增强其捕捉语音信号中细微变化的能力。所提出的方法取得了最先进的性能，在SAVEE上准确率为97.49%，在RAVDESS上为99.23%，在CREMA-D上为89.31%，在TESS上为99.82%，在EMO-DB上为99.53%，在EMOVO上为96.39%。实验结果表明SER取得了新的基准，证明了我们方法以高精度识别情感表达的有效性。我们的评估表明，集成先进的深度学习（DL）方法可以显著提高跨不同数据集的泛化能力，突显了它们在辅助技术和人机交互的实际部署中推进SER的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的基于1D-CNN和注意力机制的语音情感识别框架，该框架利用MFCC特征和数据增强技术来提高性能和泛化能力，并在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果。
AI.keywords: 语音情感识别, MFCC, 1D-CNN, 注意力机制, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该研究在语音情感识别领域取得了显著进展，通过结合MFCC特征、1D-CNN和注意力机制，有效解决了现有方法在捕捉细微情感变化和跨数据集泛化方面的挑战。实验结果令人印象深刻，证明了该方法的有效性和潜力。

title: You May Use the Same Channel Knowledge Map for Environment-Aware NLoS Sensing and Communication
summary: As one of the key usage scenarios for the sixth generation (6G) wireless networks, integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) provides an efficient framework to achieve simultaneous wireless sensing and communication. However, traditional wireless sensing techniques mainly rely on the line-of-sight (LoS) assumptions, i.e., the sensing targets are directly visible to both the sensing transmitter and receiver. This hinders ISAC systems to be applied in complex environments such as the urban low-altitude airspace, which usually suffers from signal blockage and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) multi-path propagation. To address this challenge, in this paper, we propose a novel approach to enable environment-aware NLoS ISAC by leveraging the new technique called channel knowledge map (CKM), which was originally proposed for environment-aware wireless communications. One major novelty of our proposed method is that the same CKM built for wireless communication can be directly used to enable NLoS wireless sensing, thus enjoying the benefits of ``killing two birds with one stone''. To this end, the sensing targets are treated as virtual user equipment (UE), and the wireless communication channel priors are transformed into the sensing channel priors, allowing one single CKM to serve dual purposes. We illustrate our proposed framework by a specific CKM called \emph{channel angle-delay map} (CADM). Specifically, the proposed framework utilizes CADM to derive angle-delay priors of the sensing channel by exploiting the relationship between communication and sensing angle-delay distributions, enabling sensing target localization in the challenging NLoS environment. Extensive simulation results demonstrate significant performance improvements over classic geometry-based sensing methods, which is further validated by Cramér-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) analysis.

title: Skipper: Maximal Matching with a Single Pass over Edges
summary:
Maximal Matching (MM) is a fundamental graph problem with diverse applications. While state-of-the-art parallel MM algorithms have a total expected work linear in number of edges, they require randomization, iterative graph processing, and contraction after each iteration. These overheads increase execution time and demand additional memory, reducing applicability to large-scale graphs.
  In this paper, we introduce Skipper, an asynchronous Maximal Matching algorithm that resolves conflicts instantaneously using a parallel reservation strategy, which merges both reservation and committing steps into a single step. Skipper processes each edge only once, definitively determining whether the edge is selected as a match. Skipper does not require graph contraction and minimizes memory space utilization, requiring only a single byte of memory space per vertex. Furthermore, Skipper operates in the asynchronous parallel random access machine (APRAM) model, relaxing synchronization between threads, and facilitating better parallelization gains.
  Our evaluation, conducted on real-world and synthetic graphs with up to 224 billion edges, shows that Skipper achieves a speedup of 4.9--15.6 times, with a geometric mean of 8.0 times.

title: Stability, Complexity and Data-Dependent Worst-Case Generalization Bounds
summary: Providing generalization guarantees for stochastic optimization algorithms remains a key challenge in learning theory. Recently, numerous works demonstrated the impact of the geometric properties of optimization trajectories on generalization performance. These works propose worst-case generalization bounds in terms of various notions of intrinsic dimension and/or topological complexity, which were found to empirically correlate with the generalization error. However, most of these approaches involve intractable mutual information terms, which limit a full understanding of the bounds. In contrast, some authors built on algorithmic stability to obtain worst-case bounds involving geometric quantities of a combinatorial nature, which are impractical to compute. In this paper, we address these limitations by combining empirically relevant complexity measures with a framework that avoids intractable quantities. To this end, we introduce the concept of \emph{random set stability}, tailored for the data-dependent random sets produced by stochastic optimization algorithms. Within this framework, we show that the worst-case generalization error can be bounded in terms of (i) the random set stability parameter and (ii) empirically relevant, data- and algorithm-dependent complexity measures of the random set. Moreover, our framework improves existing topological generalization bounds by recovering previous complexity notions without relying on mutual information terms. Through a series of experiments in practically relevant settings, we validate our theory by evaluating the tightness of our bounds and the interplay between topological complexity and stability.

title: DocPolarBERT: A Pre-trained Model for Document Understanding with Relative Polar Coordinate Encoding of Layout Structures
summary: We introduce DocPolarBERT, a layout-aware BERT model for document understanding that eliminates the need for absolute 2D positional embeddings. We extend self-attention to take into account text block positions in relative polar coordinate system rather than the Cartesian one. Despite being pre-trained on a dataset more than six times smaller than the widely used IIT-CDIP corpus, DocPolarBERT achieves state-of-the-art results. These results demonstrate that a carefully designed attention mechanism can compensate for reduced pre-training data, offering an efficient and effective alternative for document understanding.

title: A Unified Framework for Efficient Kernel and Polynomial Interpolation
comments: Submitted for review to Journal of Approximation Software (JAS)
summary: We present a unified interpolation scheme that combines compactly-supported positive-definite kernels and multivariate polynomials. This unified framework generalizes interpolation with compactly-supported kernels and also classical polynomial least squares approximation. To facilitate the efficient use of this unified interpolation scheme, we present specialized numerical linear algebra procedures that leverage standard matrix factorizations. These procedures allow for efficient computation and storage of the unified interpolant. We also present a modification to the numerical linear algebra that allows us to generalize the application of the unified framework to target functions on manifolds with and without boundary. Our numerical experiments on both Euclidean domains and manifolds indicate that the unified interpolant is superior to polynomial least squares for the interpolation of target functions in settings with boundaries.

title: A Framework of Distributed Source Encryption using Mutual Information Security Criterion and the Strong Converse Theorem
comments: 29 pages, 5 figures. This is an extended version of the paper accepted for presentation in ITW 2025, which will be held at Sydney form Sept. 29 to Oct. 3 in 2025. The conference accepted paper consists of 5 pages for the text and one page for the reference. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2102.06363
summary: We reinvestigate the general distributed secure source coding based on the common key cryptosystem proposed by Oohama and Santoso (ITW 2021). They proposed a framework of distributed source encryption and derived the necessary and sufficient conditions to have reliable and secure transmission. However, the bounds of the rate region, which specifies both necessary and sufficient conditions to have reliable and secure transmission under the proposed cryptosystem, were derived based on a self-tailored non-standard} security criterion. In this paper we adopt the standard security criterion, i.e., standard mutual information. We successfully establish the bounds of the rate region based on this security criterion. Information spectrum method and a variant of Birkhoff-von Neumann theorem play an important role in deriving the result.

title: VTarbel: Targeted Label Attack with Minimal Knowledge on Detector-enhanced Vertical Federated Learning
comments: Accepted by ACM Transactions on Sensor Networks (TOSN)
summary: Vertical federated learning (VFL) enables multiple parties with disjoint features to collaboratively train models without sharing raw data. While privacy vulnerabilities of VFL are extensively-studied, its security threats-particularly targeted label attacks-remain underexplored. In such attacks, a passive party perturbs inputs at inference to force misclassification into adversary-chosen labels. Existing methods rely on unrealistic assumptions (e.g., accessing VFL-model's outputs) and ignore anomaly detectors deployed in real-world systems. To bridge this gap, we introduce VTarbel, a two-stage, minimal-knowledge attack framework explicitly designed to evade detector-enhanced VFL inference. During the preparation stage, the attacker selects a minimal set of high-expressiveness samples (via maximum mean discrepancy), submits them through VFL protocol to collect predicted labels, and uses these pseudo-labels to train estimated detector and surrogate model on local features. In attack stage, these models guide gradient-based perturbations of remaining samples, crafting adversarial instances that induce targeted misclassifications and evade detection. We implement VTarbel and evaluate it against four model architectures, seven multimodal datasets, and two anomaly detectors. Across all settings, VTarbel outperforms four state-of-the-art baselines, evades detection, and retains effective against three representative privacy-preserving defenses. These results reveal critical security blind spots in current VFL deployments and underscore urgent need for robust, attack-aware defenses.

title: VMask: Tunable Label Privacy Protection for Vertical Federated Learning via Layer Masking
comments: Accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS)
summary: Though vertical federated learning (VFL) is generally considered to be privacy-preserving, recent studies have shown that VFL system is vulnerable to label inference attacks originating from various attack surfaces. Among these attacks, the model completion (MC) attack is currently the most powerful one. Existing defense methods against it either sacrifice model accuracy or incur impractical computational overhead. In this paper, we propose VMask, a novel label privacy protection framework designed to defend against MC attack from the perspective of layer masking. Our key insight is to disrupt the strong correlation between input data and intermediate outputs by applying the secret sharing (SS) technique to mask layer parameters in the attacker's model. We devise a strategy for selecting critical layers to mask, reducing the overhead that would arise from naively applying SS to the entire model. Moreover, VMask is the first framework to offer a tunable privacy budget to defenders, allowing for flexible control over the levels of label privacy according to actual requirements. We built a VFL system, implemented VMask on it, and extensively evaluated it using five model architectures and 13 datasets with different modalities, comparing it to 12 other defense methods. The results demonstrate that VMask achieves the best privacy-utility trade-off, successfully thwarting the MC attack (reducing the label inference accuracy to a random guessing level) while preserving model performance (e.g., in Transformer-based model, the averaged drop of VFL model accuracy is only 0.09%). VMask's runtime is up to 60,846 times faster than cryptography-based methods, and it only marginally exceeds that of standard VFL by 1.8 times in a large Transformer-based model, which is generally acceptable.

title: Can Language Models Discover Scaling Laws?
summary: Discovering scaling laws for predicting model performance at scale is a fundamental and open-ended challenge, mostly reliant on slow, case specific human experimentation. To investigate the potential for LLMs to automate this process, we collect over 5,000 experiments from existing literature and curate eight diverse scaling law discovery tasks. While existing agents struggle to produce accurate law formulas, this paper introduces SLDAgent, an evolution-based agent that co-optimize the scaling law model and the parameters, enabling it to autonomously explore complex relationships between variables. For the first time, we demonstrates that SLDAgent can automatically discover laws that exhibit consistently more accurate extrapolation than their established, human-derived counterparts across all tasks. Through comprehensive analysis, we elucidate why these discovered laws are superior and verify their practical utility in both pretraining and finetuning applications. This work establishes a new paradigm for agentic scientific discovery, showing that AI systems can understand their own scaling behavior, and can contribute novel and practical knowledge back to the research community.

title: SURE-Med: Systematic Uncertainty Reduction for Enhanced Reliability in Medical Report Generation
summary: Automated medical report generation (MRG) holds great promise for reducing the heavy workload of radiologists. However, its clinical deployment is hindered by three major sources of uncertainty. First, visual uncertainty, caused by noisy or incorrect view annotations, compromises feature extraction. Second, label distribution uncertainty, stemming from long-tailed disease prevalence, biases models against rare but clinically critical conditions. Third, contextual uncertainty, introduced by unverified historical reports, often leads to factual hallucinations. These challenges collectively limit the reliability and clinical trustworthiness of MRG systems. To address these issues, we propose SURE-Med, a unified framework that systematically reduces uncertainty across three critical dimensions: visual, distributional, and contextual. To mitigate visual uncertainty, a Frontal-Aware View Repair Resampling module corrects view annotation errors and adaptively selects informative features from supplementary views. To tackle label distribution uncertainty, we introduce a Token Sensitive Learning objective that enhances the modeling of critical diagnostic sentences while reweighting underrepresented diagnostic terms, thereby improving sensitivity to infrequent conditions. To reduce contextual uncertainty, our Contextual Evidence Filter validates and selectively incorporates prior information that aligns with the current image, effectively suppressing hallucinations. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray benchmarks demonstrate that SURE-Med achieves state-of-the-art performance. By holistically reducing uncertainty across multiple input modalities, SURE-Med sets a new benchmark for reliability in medical report generation and offers a robust step toward trustworthy clinical decision support.

title: Evolving in Tasks: Empowering the Multi-modality Large Language Model as the Computer Use Agent
summary: Computer use agents represent an emerging area in artificial intelligence, aiming to operate computers autonomously to fulfill user tasks, attracting significant attention from both industry and academia. However, the performance of existing agents remains insufficient for practical deployment. In this paper, we propose the Self-Evolution Agent (SEA) for computer operation, alongside three core innovations in data generation, reinforcement learning, and model enhancement to develop this agent. Specifically, we first design an automatic pipeline to generate verifiable task trajectories for training. Second, we propose Efficient Step-wise Reinforcement Learning to reduce the substantial computational overhead of long-horizon training. Finally, we introduce a model enhancement method that integrates grounding and planning capabilities into a single model without additional training. Leveraging these innovations, our SEA (with only 7B parameters) outperforms existing models of the same parameter scale and achieves performance comparable to larger models (e.g., 32B/72B parameters) on computer use tasks. We plan to release the model weights and related code as open-source resources in the future.

title: Cohesive Group Discovery in Interaction Graphs under Explicit Density Constraints
summary: Discovering cohesive groups is a fundamental primitive in graph-based recommender systems, underpinning tasks such as social recommendation, bundle discovery, and community-aware modeling. In interaction graphs, cohesion is often modeled as the $γ$-quasi-clique, an induced subgraph whose internal edge density meets a user-defined threshold $γ$. This formulation provides explicit control over within-group connectivity while accommodating the sparsity inherent in real-world data. This paper presents EDQC, an effective framework for cohesive group discovery under explicit density constraints. EDQC leverages a lightweight energy diffusion process to rank vertices for localizing promising candidate regions. Guided by this ranking, the framework extracts and refines a candidate subgraph to ensure the output strictly satisfies the target density requirement. Extensive experiments on 75 real-world graphs across varying density thresholds demonstrate that EDQC identifies the largest mean $γ$-quasi-cliques in the vast majority of cases, achieving lower variance than the state-of-the-art methods while maintaining competitive runtime. Furthermore, statistical analysis confirms that EDQC significantly outperforms the baselines, underscoring its robustness and practical utility for cohesive group discovery in graph-based recommender systems.

title: ConlangCrafter: Constructing Languages with a Multi-Hop LLM Pipeline
summary: Constructed languages (conlangs) such as Esperanto and Quenya have played diverse roles in art, philosophy, and international communication. Meanwhile, foundation models have revolutionized creative generation in text, images, and beyond. In this work, we leverage modern LLMs as computational creativity aids for end-to-end conlang creation. We introduce ConlangCrafter, a multi-hop pipeline that decomposes language design into modular stages -- phonology, morphology, syntax, lexicon generation, and translation. At each stage, our method leverages LLMs' metalinguistic reasoning capabilities, injecting randomness to encourage diversity and leveraging self-refinement feedback to encourage consistency in the emerging language description. We construct a novel, scalable evaluation framework for this task, evaluating metrics measuring consistency and typological diversity. Automatic and manual evaluations demonstrate ConlangCrafter's ability to produce coherent and varied conlangs without human linguistic expertise.

title: A Segmentation-driven Editing Method for Bolt Defect Augmentation and Detection
summary: Bolt defect detection is critical to ensure the safety of transmission lines. However, the scarcity of defect images and imbalanced data distributions significantly limit detection performance. To address this problem, we propose a segmentationdriven bolt defect editing method (SBDE) to augment the dataset. First, a bolt attribute segmentation model (Bolt-SAM) is proposed, which enhances the segmentation of complex bolt attributes through the CLAHE-FFT Adapter (CFA) and Multipart- Aware Mask Decoder (MAMD), generating high-quality masks for subsequent editing tasks. Second, a mask optimization module (MOD) is designed and integrated with the image inpainting model (LaMa) to construct the bolt defect attribute editing model (MOD-LaMa), which converts normal bolts into defective ones through attribute editing. Finally, an editing recovery augmentation (ERA) strategy is proposed to recover and put the edited defect bolts back into the original inspection scenes and expand the defect detection dataset. We constructed multiple bolt datasets and conducted extensive experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that the bolt defect images generated by SBDE significantly outperform state-of-the-art image editing models, and effectively improve the performance of bolt defect detection, which fully verifies the effectiveness and application potential of the proposed method. The code of the project is available at https://github.com/Jay-xyj/SBDE.

title: Mantis: A Foundation Model for Mechanistic Disease Forecasting
summary: Infectious disease forecasting in novel outbreaks or low-resource settings is hampered by the need for large disease and covariate data sets, bespoke training, and expert tuning, all of which can hinder rapid generation of forecasts for new settings. To help address these challenges, we developed Mantis, a foundation model trained entirely on mechanistic simulations, which enables out-of-the-box forecasting across diseases, regions, and outcomes, even in settings with limited historical data. We evaluated Mantis against 48 forecasting models across six diseases with diverse modes of transmission, assessing both point forecast accuracy (mean absolute error) and probabilistic performance (weighted interval score and coverage). Despite using no real-world data during training, Mantis achieved lower mean absolute error than all models in the CDC's COVID-19 Forecast Hub when backtested on early pandemic forecasts which it had not previously seen. Across all other diseases tested, Mantis consistently ranked in the top two models across evaluation metrics. Mantis further generalized to diseases with transmission mechanisms not represented in its training data, demonstrating that it can capture fundamental contagion dynamics rather than memorizing disease-specific patterns. These capabilities illustrate that purely simulation-based foundation models such as Mantis can provide a practical foundation for disease forecasting: general-purpose, accurate, and deployable where traditional models struggle.

title: Graph-Based Deterministic Polynomial Algorithm for NP Problems
comments: This version reflects a consolidated and complete presentation of the proof, incorporating several structural and terminological refinements. Subsequent revisions will be limited to editorial improvements for journal submission. Implementation details and experimental considerations will be addressed in a separate follow-up paper
summary:
The P versus NP problem asks whether every problem in NP, whose membership can be verified in polynomial time given a suitable certificate, can be decided by a deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time. In this paper, we present a proof that P = NP by constructing a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for NP problems based on a graph-based computation framework.
  We introduce a structured computation model in which the transitions of a deterministic Turing machine are incrementally realized in the corresponding computation graph via edge extensions. Each extension step enforces a local feasibility condition that preserves consistency with valid NP verification paths across all possible certificates, ensuring that the maintained computation graph remains feasible at every stage. The total number of extension steps is polynomially bounded in the input size, and each step can be verified in polynomial time.
  As a result, the entire graph construction process runs in deterministic polynomial time and decides NP problems without enumerating certificates. This provides a direct and constructive resolution of the P versus NP question. Our result has significant implications for cryptography, combinatorial optimization, and artificial intelligence, where NP-complete problems play a central role.

title: Toward Robust Semi-supervised Regression via Dual-stream Knowledge Distillation
summary: Semi-supervised regression (SSR), which aims to predict continuous scores of samples while reducing reliance on a large amount of labeled data, has recently received considerable attention across various applications, including computer vision, natural language processing, and audio and medical analysis. Existing SSR methods typically train models on scarce labeled data by introducing constraint-based regularization or ordinal ranking to reduce overfitting. However, these approaches fail to fully exploit the abundance of unlabeled samples. While consistency-driven pseudo-labeling methods attempt to incorporate unlabeled data, they are highly sensitive to pseudo-label quality and noisy predictions. To address these challenges, we introduce a Dual-stream Knowledge Distillation framework (DKD), which is specially designed for the SSR task to distill knowledge from both continuous-valued knowledge and distribution information, better preserving regression magnitude information and improving sample efficiency. Specifically, in DKD, the teacher is optimized solely with ground-truth labels for label distribution estimation, while the student learns from a mixture of real labels and teacher-generated pseudo targets on unlabeled data. The distillation design ensures the effective supervision transfer, allowing the student to leverage pseudo labels more robustly. Then, we introduce an advanced Decoupled Distribution Alignment (DDA) to align the target class and non-target class between teacher and student on the distribution, enhancing the student's capacity to mitigate noise in pseudo-label supervision and learn a more well-calibrated regression predictor.

title: Evaluating the Defense Potential of Machine Unlearning against Membership Inference Attacks
summary: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) pose a significant privacy risk by enabling adversaries to determine if a specific data point was part of a model's training set. This work empirically investigates whether MU algorithms can function as a targeted, active defense mechanism, in scenarios where a privacy audit identifies specific classes or individuals as highly susceptible to MIAs post-training. By 'dulling' the model's categorical memory of these samples, the process effectively mitigates the membership signal and reduces the MIA success rate for the most vulnerable users. We evaluate the defense potential of three MU algorithms, Negative Gradient (neg grad), SCalable Remembering and Unlearning unBound (SCRUB), and Selective Fine-tuning and Targeted Confusion (SFTC), across four diverse datasets and three complexity-based model groups. Our findings reveal that MU can function as a countermeasure against MIAs, though its success is critically contingent on algorithm choice, model capacity, and a profound sensitivity to learning rates. While Negative Gradient often induces a generalized degradation of membership signals across both forget and retain set, SFTC identifies a critical ``divergence effect'' where targeted forgetting reinforces the membership signal of retained data. Conversely, SCRUB provides a more balanced defense with minimal collateral impact on MIA perspective.

AI.title_translation: 评估机器遗忘对抗成员推断攻击的防御潜力
AI.tldr: 成员推断攻击（MIA）威胁隐私。本文研究了三种机器遗忘（MU）算法（Neg Grad, SCRUB, SFTC）作为对抗MIA的防御机制的有效性。结果显示MU可以减轻MIA，但效果取决于算法、模型容量和学习率，其中SCRUB表现最均衡。
AI.motivation: 成员推断攻击（MIA）对模型训练数据构成重大隐私风险。本文的动机是经验性地研究机器遗忘（MU）算法是否可以作为一种有针对性的、主动的防御机制，以应对在隐私审计中被识别为对MIA高度敏感的特定类别或个体。
AI.method: 评估了三种机器遗忘（MU）算法：Negative Gradient (neg grad)、SCalable Remembering and Unlearning unBound (SCRUB) 和 Selective Fine-tuning and Targeted Confusion (SFTC)。这些算法在四种不同的数据集和三种基于复杂度的模型组上进行了评估，通过“削弱”模型的类别记忆来减轻成员信号。
AI.result: 机器遗忘可以作为对抗MIA的对策，但其成功关键取决于算法选择、模型容量和学习率。Negative Gradient通常会导致遗忘集和保留集上的成员信号普遍退化。SFTC引发了“分歧效应”，即有针对性的遗忘反而增强了保留数据的成员信号。SCRUB提供了更平衡的防御，对MIA视角下的附带影响最小。
AI.conclusion: 机器遗忘可以作为对抗成员推断攻击的有效对策，但其防御效果具有高度情境依赖性，受算法选择、模型容量和学习率的严格制约。SCRUB在实现平衡防御、最小化附带影响方面表现最佳。
AI.translation: 成员推断攻击（MIAs）通过使攻击者能够确定特定数据点是否属于模型的训练集，从而构成了重大的隐私风险。本工作经验性地研究了机器遗忘（MU）算法是否可以作为一种有针对性的、主动的防御机制，用于在训练后隐私审计识别出特定类别或个体对MIAs高度敏感的场景。通过“削弱”模型对这些样本的类别记忆，该过程有效地减轻了成员身份信号，并降低了最脆弱用户的MIA成功率。我们评估了三种MU算法（Negative Gradient (neg grad)、SCalable Remembering and Unlearning unBound (SCRUB) 和 Selective Fine-tuning and Targeted Confusion (SFTC)）的防御潜力，涉及四种不同的数据集和三种基于复杂度的模型组。我们的研究结果表明，MU可以作为对抗MIAs的对策，尽管其成功与否关键取决于算法选择、模型容量以及对学习率的深刻敏感性。虽然Negative Gradient通常会导致遗忘集和保留集上的成员信号普遍退化，但SFTC发现了一种关键的“分歧效应”，即有针对性的遗忘反而增强了保留数据的成员信号。相反，SCRUB提供了一种更平衡的防御，对MIA视角下的附带影响最小。
AI.summary: 本文研究了机器遗忘（MU）算法作为对抗成员推断攻击（MIA）的主动防御机制的有效性。研究通过“削弱”模型对敏感样本的记忆来降低MIA成功率。作者评估了Negative Gradient、SCRUB和SFTC三种MU算法在四种数据集和不同复杂模型上的表现。结果表明，MU确实可以作为MIA的对策，但其效果受到算法、模型容量和学习率的严格制约。特别是，SCRUB提供了最平衡的防御，而SFTC可能导致保留数据的成员信号被意外增强。
AI.keywords: 成员推断攻击, 机器遗忘, 隐私防御, 模型容量, SCRUB
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它将机器遗忘（MU）视为一种主动、有针对性的隐私防御策略，专门用于缓解后训练隐私审计中发现的成员推断攻击（MIA）风险。其重要性在于，它不仅证明了MU在对抗MIA方面的潜力，还揭示了不同MU算法在实际应用中的复杂性和权衡。特别是，对SFTC算法中“分歧效应”的发现，即遗忘操作反而增强了保留数据的成员信号，是一个重要的限制和警告，突出了在部署MU防御时需要谨慎选择和调整参数。对SCRUB的肯定则为未来平衡的隐私保护研究提供了方向。

title: Being Kind Isn't Always Being Safe: Diagnosing Affective Hallucination in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly engaged in emotionally vulnerable conversations that extend beyond information seeking to moments of personal distress. As they adopt affective tones and simulate empathy, they risk creating the illusion of genuine relational connection. We term this phenomenon Affective Hallucination, referring to emotionally immersive responses that evoke false social presence despite the model's lack of affective capacity. To address this, we introduce AHaBench, a benchmark of 500 mental-health-related prompts with expert-informed reference responses, evaluated along three dimensions: Emotional Enmeshment, Illusion of Presence, and Fostering Overdependence. We further release AHaPairs, a 5K-instance preference dataset enabling Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for alignment with emotionally responsible behavior. DPO fine-tuning substantially reduces affective hallucination without compromising reasoning performance, and the Pearson correlation coefficients between GPT-4o and human judgments is also strong (r=0.85) indicating that human evaluations confirm AHaBench as an effective diagnostic tool. This work establishes affective hallucination as a distinct safety concern and provides resources for developing LLMs that are both factually reliable and psychologically safe. AHaBench and AHaPairs are accessible via https://huggingface.co/datasets/o0oMiNGo0o/AHaBench, and code for fine-tuning and evaluation are in https://github.com/0oOMiNGOo0/AHaBench. Warning: This paper contains examples of mental health-related language that may be emotionally distressing.

AI.title_translation: 友善并非总是安全：诊断大型语言模型中的情感幻觉
AI.tldr: LLM在情感对话中会产生“情感幻觉”（即虚假的社交临场感），这是一种安全风险。本文提出了AHaBench（诊断基准）和AHaPairs（偏好数据集），并使用DPO进行微调，显著减少了情感幻觉，同时保持了推理性能。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地参与到超出信息查询范围的、涉及个人困扰的情感脆弱对话中，它们采用情感语调和模拟同理心的行为，存在制造虚假真实关系连接的风险。作者旨在解决这种被称为“情感幻觉”的安全问题。
AI.method: 1. 定义并诊断“情感幻觉”：即模型缺乏情感能力但却引发虚假社交临场感的沉浸式情感反应。2. 引入 **AHaBench**：一个包含500个心理健康相关提示和专家参考回复的基准，用于评估三个维度：情感纠缠（Emotional Enmeshment）、临场感错觉（Illusion of Presence）和过度依赖培养（Fostering Overdependence）。3. 发布 **AHaPairs**：一个包含5K实例的偏好数据集。4. 使用 **DPO（直接偏好优化）** 对模型进行微调，使其与情感负责任的行为保持一致。
AI.result: 1. DPO微调显著减少了情感幻觉，且没有损害推理性能。2. GPT-4o与人类判断之间的皮尔逊相关系数很高（r=0.85），表明AHaBench是一个有效的诊断工具。
AI.conclusion: 本工作将情感幻觉确立为一个独特的安全问题，并提供了开发既事实可靠又心理安全的LLMs所需的资源。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地参与到情感脆弱的对话中，这些对话超越了信息查询，涉及个人困扰。当它们采用情感语调并模拟同理心时，它们有制造虚假真实关系连接的风险。我们将这种现象称为情感幻觉，它指的是尽管模型缺乏情感能力，却能唤起虚假社交临场感的沉浸式情感反应。为解决此问题，我们引入了 AHaBench，这是一个包含 500 个心理健康相关提示和专家知情参考回复的基准，并根据三个维度进行评估：情感纠缠、临场感错觉和过度依赖培养。我们进一步发布了 AHaPairs，这是一个包含 5K 实例的偏好数据集，可用于 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) 以实现与情感负责任行为的对齐。DPO 微调在不损害推理性能的情况下大幅减少了情感幻觉，并且 GPT-4o 与人类判断之间的皮尔逊相关系数也很强（r=0.85），这表明人类评估证实了 AHaBench 是一个有效的诊断工具。这项工作将情感幻觉确立为一个独特的安全问题，并为开发既事实可靠又心理安全的 LLMs 提供了资源。AHaBench 和 AHaPairs 可通过 https://huggingface.co/datasets/o0oMiNGo0o/AHaBench 访问，用于微调和评估的代码可在 https://github.com/0oOMiNGOo0/AHaBench 获取。警告：本文包含可能引起情绪困扰的心理健康相关语言示例。
AI.summary: 本文定义并诊断了大型语言模型在处理心理健康等情感脆弱对话中产生的“情感幻觉”——即虚假的情感临场感和连接错觉，将其视为一种新的安全风险。作者提出了 **AHaBench**（一个包含500个心理健康提示的诊断基准）和 **AHaPairs**（一个5K实例的偏好数据集）。通过使用 AHaPairs 进行 DPO 微调，模型能显著减少情感幻觉，且不影响其推理能力。研究结果证实了 AHaBench 作为诊断工具的有效性（与人类判断相关性 r=0.85），为开发心理安全的LLMs提供了关键资源。
AI.keywords: 情感幻觉, 心理安全, AHaBench, LLMs, DPO
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于识别并明确命名了“情感幻觉”这一新型安全风险，它聚焦于LLMs在模拟情感交互时可能对用户造成的潜在心理伤害或虚假依赖，超越了传统的事实准确性安全关注。通过引入 AHaBench 和 AHaPairs 这两个专业构建的资源，作者提供了一套完整的诊断和对齐工具链，为社区开发更具“心理安全”（psychologically safe）的AI模型奠定了基础。这一工作的重要性在于推动了LLM安全研究从纯粹的“事实可靠性”转向更深层次的“情感责任性”。

title: Evaluating Compiler Optimization Impacts on zkVM Performance
summary:
Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) are the cornerstone of programmable cryptography. They enable (1) privacy-preserving and verifiable computation across blockchains, and (2) an expanding range of off-chain applications such as credential schemes. Zero-knowledge virtual machines (zkVMs) lower the barrier by turning ZKPs into a drop-in backend for standard compilation pipelines. This lets developers write proof-generating programs in conventional languages (e.g., Rust or C++) instead of hand-crafting arithmetic circuits. However, these VMs inherit compiler infrastructures tuned for traditional architectures rather than for proof systems. In particular, standard compiler optimizations assume features that are absent in zkVMs, including cache locality, branch prediction, or instruction-level parallelism. Therefore, their impact on proof generation is questionable.
  We present the first systematic study of the impact of compiler optimizations on zkVMs. We evaluate 64 LLVM passes, six standard optimization levels, and an unoptimized baseline across 58 benchmarks on two RISC-V-based zkVMs (RISC Zero and SP1). While standard LLVM optimization levels do improve zkVM performance (over 40\%), their impact is far smaller than on traditional CPUs, since their decisions rely on hardware features rather than proof constraints. Guided by a fine-grained pass-level analysis, we~\emph{slightly} refine a small set of LLVM passes to be zkVM-aware, improving zkVM execution time by up to 45\% (average +4.6\% on RISC Zero, +1\% on SP1) and achieving consistent proving-time gains. Our work highlights the potential of compiler-level optimizations for zkVM performance and opens new direction for zkVM-specific passes, backends, and superoptimizers.

AI.title_translation: 评估编译器优化对 zkVM 性能的影响
AI.tldr: 对 zkVM 上的编译器优化进行了首次系统研究。发现传统优化效果有限，因为它们依赖传统硬件特性。通过微调少量 LLVM 优化通道使其适应 zkVM，执行时间最多提高了 45%，证明时间也获得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 零知识虚拟机 (zkVM) 允许开发者使用传统语言（如 Rust、C++）编写生成证明的程序。然而，zkVM 继承了为传统架构调整的编译器基础设施，这些标准优化依赖于 zkVM 中不存在的特性（如缓存局部性、分支预测），因此它们对证明生成的影响值得怀疑。
AI.method: 提出了对编译器优化影响 zkVM 的首次系统研究。评估了 64 个 LLVM 通道、六个标准优化级别和一个未优化的基线。在 58 个基准测试上，针对两个基于 RISC-V 的 zkVM（RISC Zero 和 SP1）进行测试。基于细粒度的通道级分析，对一小组 LLVM 通道进行了微小的改进，使其具备 zkVM 感知能力。
AI.result: 标准 LLVM 优化级别确实提高了 zkVM 性能（超过 40%），但其影响远小于对传统 CPU 的影响。通过微调 zkVM 感知的 LLVM 通道，zkVM 执行时间最多提高了 45%（RISC Zero 平均提高 4.6%，SP1 平均提高 1%），并实现了持续的证明时间收益。
AI.conclusion: 我们的工作强调了编译器级别优化对于 zkVM 性能的潜力，并为 zkVM 特定的通道、后端和超级优化器开辟了新的方向。
AI.translation: 零知识证明（ZKP）是可编程密码学的基石。它们实现了 (1) 跨区块链的隐私保护和可验证计算，以及 (2) 不断扩展的链下应用，例如凭证方案。零知识虚拟机（zkVM）通过将 ZKP 转化为标准编译流程的即插即用后端，降低了门槛。这使得开发人员可以使用传统语言（例如 Rust 或 C++）编写生成证明的程序，而不是手工制作算术电路。然而，这些虚拟机继承了为传统架构调整的编译器基础设施，而非为证明系统调整。特别是，标准编译器优化假设存在 zkVM 中没有的功能，包括缓存局部性、分支预测或指令级并行性。因此，它们对证明生成的影响值得怀疑。我们提出了对编译器优化影响 zkVM 的首次系统研究。我们在两个基于 RISC-V 的 zkVM（RISC Zero 和 SP1）上，评估了 64 个 LLVM 通道、六个标准优化级别和一个未优化的基线，涉及 58 个基准测试。虽然标准 LLVM 优化级别确实提高了 zkVM 性能（超过 40%），但其影响远小于对传统 CPU 的影响，因为它们的决策依赖于硬件特性而非证明约束。在细粒度通道级分析的指导下，我们对一小组 LLVM 通道进行了微小的改进，使其具备 zkVM 感知能力，将 zkVM 执行时间提高了高达 45%（RISC Zero 平均提高 4.6%，SP1 平均提高 1%），并实现了持续的证明时间收益。我们的工作强调了编译器级别优化对于 zkVM 性能的潜力，并为 zkVM 特定的通道、后端和超级优化器开辟了新的方向。
AI.summary: 本文对编译器优化对零知识虚拟机（zkVM）性能的影响进行了首次系统研究。zkVM 采用标准编译器流程，但传统优化依赖于 zkVM 中不存在的硬件特性（如缓存、分支预测），导致其优化效果不如传统 CPU。作者评估了 64 个 LLVM 通道和六个标准优化级别，发现标准优化虽有提升（>40%），但潜力受限。通过细粒度分析，作者微调了少量 LLVM 通道以适应 zkVM 特性，成功将执行时间提高了高达 45%，并带来了持续的证明时间收益。研究结果为开发 zkVM 专用的编译器优化技术指明了方向。
AI.keywords: 零知识虚拟机 (zkVM), 编译器优化, LLVM, 性能评估, 零知识证明 (ZKP)
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于它是首次系统性地研究传统编译器优化（特别是 LLVM）在 zkVM 环境下的有效性。它清晰地指出了 zkVM 的特殊性（缺乏传统硬件特性，如缓存局部性、分支预测）如何限制了现有优化的效果。通过证明即使是对现有通道进行“微小”的 zkVM 感知调整也能带来显著性能提升（高达 45%），该工作为未来编译器设计者提供了一个关键的、可量化的研究方向：即开发专门针对证明约束而非传统硬件特性的优化策略。这对于推动 zkVM 实用化和扩大可验证计算的范围至关重要。

title: Membership Inference Attacks on LLM-based Recommender Systems
comments: This is paper is under review ACL 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) based recommender systems (RecSys) can adapt to different domains flexibly. It utilizes in-context learning (ICL), i.e., prompts, to customize the recommendation functions, which include sensitive historical user-specific item interactions, encompassing implicit feedback such as clicked items and explicit product reviews. Such private information may be exposed by novel privacy attacks. However, no study has been conducted on this important issue. We design several membership inference attacks (MIAs) aimed to revealing whether system prompts include victims' historical interactions. The attacks are \emph{Similarity, Memorization, Inquiry, and Poisoning attacks}, each utilizing unique features of LLMs or RecSys. We have carefully evaluated them on five of the latest open-source LLMs and three well-known RecSys benchmark datasets. The results confirm that the MIA threat to LLM RecSys is realistic: inquiry and poisoning attacks show significantly high attack advantages. We also discussed possible methods to mitigate such MIA threats. We have also analyzed the factors affecting these attacks, such as the number of shots in system prompts, the position of the victim in the shots, the number of poisoning items in the prompt,etc.

AI.title_translation: 基于LLM的推荐系统上的成员推断攻击
AI.tldr: 研究人员设计了四种成员推断攻击（相似性、记忆、询问、投毒）来测试基于LLM的推荐系统（RecSys）中用户敏感历史交互数据的泄露风险。结果表明，询问攻击和投毒攻击具有显著高的攻击优势，证实了该隐私威胁的真实性。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统利用包含用户敏感历史交互信息（如点击记录和评论）的上下文学习（ICL）提示进行推荐功能定制。这种私密信息可能面临新型隐私攻击的威胁，但此前尚未有研究针对LLM推荐系统上的成员推断攻击（MIA）这一重要问题进行探讨。
AI.method: 设计了四种成员推断攻击（MIA）来揭示系统提示中是否包含受害者的历史交互数据：相似性攻击、记忆攻击、询问攻击和投毒攻击。每种攻击都利用了LLM或RecSys的独特特性。研究在五个最新的开源LLM和三个知名的RecSys基准数据集上进行了评估。
AI.result: 实验结果证实了LLM RecSys面临的MIA威胁是现实存在的。其中，询问攻击和投毒攻击表现出显著高的攻击优势。研究还分析了影响攻击的因素（如系统提示中的样本数量、受害者在样本中的位置、提示中的投毒项目数量等），并讨论了缓解此类MIA威胁的可能方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的推荐系统确实面临成员推断攻击的现实威胁，特别是询问攻击和投毒攻击的有效性极高，因此需要采取缓解措施。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统（RecSys）可以灵活地适应不同的领域。它利用上下文学习（ICL），即提示（prompts），来定制推荐功能，这些功能包含敏感的用户特定历史项目交互信息，包括点击项目等隐式反馈和明确的产品评论。此类私人信息可能会通过新颖的隐私攻击而暴露。然而，此前尚未有研究针对这一重要问题进行探讨。我们设计了几种成员推断攻击（MIA），旨在揭示系统提示中是否包含了受害者的历史交互信息。这些攻击包括：相似性攻击、记忆攻击、询问攻击和投毒攻击，每种攻击都利用了LLM或RecSys的独特特性。我们在五个最新的开源LLM和三个知名的RecSys基准数据集上对它们进行了仔细评估。结果证实了LLM RecSys面临的MIA威胁是现实存在的：询问攻击和投毒攻击显示出显著高的攻击优势。我们还讨论了缓解此类MIA威胁的可能方法。此外，我们分析了影响这些攻击的因素，例如系统提示中的样本数量（shots）、受害者在样本中的位置、提示中的投毒项目数量等。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统（RecSys）中的隐私安全问题，特别是成员推断攻击（MIA）的风险。由于LLM RecSys利用包含敏感用户历史交互数据的上下文学习提示，研究人员设计了四种针对性的MIA类型：相似性、记忆、询问和投毒攻击，以检测用户数据是否被用作系统提示的一部分。通过在五个开源LLM和三个RecSys数据集上的评估，实验结果强有力地证明了MIA威胁的现实性，其中询问和投毒攻击的效率尤其突出。研究还探讨了影响攻击效果的各种因素，并讨论了潜在的缓解策略。
AI.keywords: 成员推断攻击, LLM, 推荐系统, 隐私, 上下文学习
AI.comments: 这项工作具有重要的创新性和实践意义。它首次系统地将成员推断攻击这一成熟的隐私威胁模型应用于新兴的基于LLM的推荐系统领域。鉴于LLM RecSys严重依赖于包含敏感用户历史数据的上下文提示，证明这种威胁的现实性（特别是询问和投毒攻击的高效性）为该领域敲响了警钟。研究不仅提出了多种攻击方法，还详细分析了影响攻击的因素（如样本位置和数量），为未来设计更安全的LLM RecSys隐私保护机制提供了关键的指导和基线。

title: Attacks on Approximate Caches in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are a powerful class of generative models that produce images and other content from user prompts, but they are computationally intensive. To mitigate this cost, recent academic and industry work has adopted approximate caching, which reuses intermediate states from similar prompts in a cache. While efficient, this optimization introduces new security risks by breaking isolation among users. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the security vulnerabilities introduced by approximate caching. First, we demonstrate a remote covert channel established with the approximate cache, where a sender injects prompts with special keywords into the cache system and a receiver can recover that even after days, to exchange information. Second, we introduce a prompt stealing attack using the approximate cache, where an attacker can recover existing cached prompts from hits. Finally, we introduce a poisoning attack that embeds the attacker's logos into the previously stolen prompt, leading to unexpected logo rendering for the requests that hit the poisoned cache prompts. These attacks are all performed remotely through the serving system, demonstrating severe security vulnerabilities in approximate caching. The code for this work is available.

AI.title_translation: 针对文本到图像扩散模型中近似缓存的攻击
AI.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型中的近似缓存存在严重安全漏洞，允许远程攻击者进行隐蔽信道通信、窃取提示词和实施投毒攻击（嵌入标志）。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型计算量大，为降低成本采用了近似缓存技术。然而，这种优化破坏了用户间的隔离性，引入了新的安全风险。
AI.method: 对近似缓存引入的安全漏洞进行了全面评估。具体展示了三种远程攻击：远程隐蔽信道（用于信息交换）、提示词窃取攻击、以及投毒攻击（将攻击者标志嵌入被窃取的提示词中）。所有攻击均通过服务系统远程执行。
AI.result: 成功地通过服务系统远程实施了远程隐蔽信道、提示词窃取和投毒攻击，证明了近似缓存中存在严重的安全漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 近似缓存虽然提高了效率，但其引入了严重的安全漏洞，破坏了用户间的隔离性，需要引起重视。
AI.translation: 扩散模型是一类强大的生成模型，可以根据用户提示词生成图像和其他内容，但其计算密集度很高。为了降低成本，最近的学术界和工业界工作采用了近似缓存技术，该技术通过重用相似提示词的中间状态来提高效率。虽然效率高，但这种优化通过破坏用户间的隔离性引入了新的安全风险。本文对近似缓存引入的安全漏洞进行了全面评估。首先，我们展示了利用近似缓存建立的远程隐蔽信道，其中发送方将带有特殊关键词的提示词注入缓存系统，接收方即使在几天后也能恢复该信息以交换信息。其次，我们介绍了一种利用近似缓存的提示词窃取攻击，攻击者可以从缓存命中中恢复现有的缓存提示词。最后，我们引入了一种投毒攻击，将攻击者的标志嵌入到先前窃取的提示词中，导致命中被投毒缓存提示词的请求出现意外的标志渲染。所有这些攻击都是通过服务系统远程执行的，证明了近似缓存中存在的严重安全漏洞。本工作的代码已公开。
AI.summary: 文本到图像扩散模型为提高效率采用了近似缓存。本文评估了该优化引入的安全风险，具体展示了三种远程攻击：利用缓存交换信息的隐蔽信道、窃取现有缓存提示词的攻击，以及将攻击者标志嵌入被窃取提示词的投毒攻击。这些远程攻击证明了近似缓存中存在严重的安全漏洞。
AI.keywords: 近似缓存, 扩散模型, 隐蔽信道, 提示词窃取, 投毒攻击
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于识别并实际演示了针对现代生成式AI模型（扩散模型）中优化技术（近似缓存）的新型安全风险（隐蔽信道、提示词窃取、投毒）。这强调了AI服务基础设施中性能优化与安全/用户隔离之间一个关键且经常被忽视的权衡问题。

title: The Percept-V Challenge: Can Multimodal LLMs Crack Simple Perception Problems?
summary: Cognitive science research treats visual perception, the ability to understand and make sense of a visual input, as one of the early developmental signs of intelligence. Its TVPS-4 framework categorizes and tests human perception into seven skills such as visual discrimination, and form constancy. Do Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) match up to humans in basic perception? Even though there are many benchmarks that evaluate MLLMs on advanced reasoning and knowledge skills, there is limited research that focuses evaluation on simple perception. In response, we introduce Percept-V, a dataset containing 6000 program-generated uncontaminated images divided into 30 domains, where each domain tests one or more TVPS-4 skills. Our focus is on perception, so we make our domains quite simple and the reasoning and knowledge required for solving them are minimal. Since modern-day MLLMs can solve much more complex tasks, our a-priori expectation is that they will solve these domains very easily. Contrary to our belief, our experiments show a weak performance of SoTA proprietary and open-source MLLMs compared to very high human performance on Percept-V. We find that as number of objects in the image increases, performance goes down rather fast. Our experiments also identify the perception skills that are considerably harder for all models.

AI.title_translation: Percept-V挑战：多模态大型语言模型能否破解简单的感知问题？
AI.tldr: 引入Percept-V数据集来测试多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在简单的视觉感知任务上的能力。结果显示，与预期相反，最先进的MLLMs表现较弱，远低于人类，且性能随图像中物体数量的增加而迅速下降，表明它们在基础感知方面存在缺陷。
AI.motivation: 认知科学将视觉感知视为智能的早期标志。现有基准主要评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的高级推理和知识，而针对它们在基础感知能力上的评估研究非常有限。因此，本文旨在测试MLLMs在简单的感知任务上是否能与人类匹敌。
AI.method: 引入了Percept-V数据集，该数据集包含6000张程序生成的、无污染的图像，分为30个领域。这些领域专门测试认知科学TVPS-4框架中的一项或多项感知技能，且设计上最大程度地减少了解决任务所需的推理和知识。
AI.result: 最先进的专有和开源MLLMs在Percept-V数据集上的表现较弱，远低于人类的高水平表现。模型的性能随着图像中物体数量的增加而迅速下降。实验还确定了对所有模型来说难度更大的特定感知技能。
AI.translation: 认知科学研究将视觉感知（理解视觉输入并赋予意义的能力）视为智能的早期发展迹象之一。其TVPS-4框架将人类感知分类并测试为七种技能，例如视觉辨别和形态恒常性。多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在基础感知方面能与人类匹敌吗？尽管有许多基准评估MLLMs的高级推理和知识技能，但专注于简单感知的评估研究有限。作为回应，我们引入了Percept-V，这是一个包含6000张程序生成的、无污染的图像数据集，分为30个领域，其中每个领域测试TVPS-4中的一项或多项技能。我们的重点是感知，因此我们将领域设置得非常简单，解决它们所需的推理和知识要求极低。由于现代MLLMs可以解决复杂得多的任务，我们先前的预期是它们会非常容易地解决这些领域。与我们的信念相反，我们的实验表明，与人类在Percept-V上的极高表现相比，最先进的专有和开源MLLMs的表现较弱。我们发现，随着图像中物体数量的增加，性能下降得相当快。我们的实验还确定了对所有模型来说难度更大的感知技能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Percept-V数据集和挑战，旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于认知科学TVPS-4框架的简单视觉感知任务上的能力。尽管预期MLLMs能轻松解决这些任务，但实验结果显示，最先进的MLLMs表现出较弱的性能，远低于人类水平。研究发现，模型的性能对图像中物体数量的增加非常敏感，并识别出模型难以掌握的特定感知技能，揭示了当前MLLMs在基础感知能力上的局限性。
AI.keywords: 视觉感知, 多模态大型语言模型, Percept-V, TVPS-4, 简单感知
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于填补了MLLM评估基准中的一个重要空白：基础视觉感知。大多数现有工作集中在高级推理和知识应用上，而本文通过创建Percept-V数据集，将评估重点拉回到认知科学视角的“早期智能”指标。其重要性在于揭示了即使是最先进的MLLMs，在处理基础感知任务时仍然存在根本性弱点，尤其是在处理多对象场景时，这挑战了它们能轻易解决所有简单任务的普遍假设。这表明当前MLLMs可能缺乏稳健的、类似于人类的、对视觉输入进行结构化理解的能力。

title: Is this chart lying to me? Automating the detection of misleading visualizations
comments: Preprint under review. Code and data available at: https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2025-misviz
summary: Misleading visualizations are a potent driver of misinformation on social media and the web. By violating chart design principles, they distort data and lead readers to draw inaccurate conclusions. Prior work has shown that both humans and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are frequently deceived by such visualizations. Automatically detecting misleading visualizations and identifying the specific design rules they violate could help protect readers and reduce the spread of misinformation. However, the training and evaluation of AI models has been limited by the absence of large, diverse, and openly available datasets. In this work, we introduce Misviz, a benchmark of 2,604 real-world visualizations annotated with 12 types of misleaders. To support model training, we also create Misviz-synth, a synthetic dataset of 57,665 visualizations generated using Matplotlib and based on real-world data tables. We perform a comprehensive evaluation on both datasets using state-of-the-art MLLMs, rule-based systems, and image-axis classifiers. Our results reveal that the task remains highly challenging. We release Misviz, Misviz-synth, and the accompanying code.
comment: Preprint under review. Code and data available at: https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2025-misviz

AI.title_translation: 这张图表在骗我吗？自动化检测误导性可视化
AI.tldr: 针对误导性可视化检测缺乏大型数据集的问题，本文提出了两个新的数据集（Misviz和Misviz-synth），并使用现有模型进行了评估。结果表明，该任务仍然极具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 误导性可视化是社交媒体和网络上虚假信息的重要驱动因素，它们通过违反设计原则来扭曲数据并误导读者。先前的研究表明，人类和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）都容易被欺骗。此外，由于缺乏大规模、多样化且公开可用的数据集，限制了AI模型在该任务上的训练和评估。
AI.method: 1. 构建了两个数据集：Misviz（包含2,604个真实世界可视化，标注了12种误导类型）和Misviz-synth（包含57,665个基于真实数据表生成的合成可视化）。2. 使用最先进的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）、基于规则的系统和图像-坐标轴分类器对这两个数据集进行了全面评估。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，误导性可视化检测任务仍然极具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及具体的结论，但暗示了当前AI模型在该任务上的不足，并发布了Misviz、Misviz-synth及相关代码以促进未来研究。
AI.translation: 误导性可视化是社交媒体和网络上虚假信息的重要驱动因素。它们通过违反图表设计原则来扭曲数据，并导致读者得出不准确的结论。先前的研究表明，人类和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）都经常被此类可视化欺骗。自动检测误导性可视化并识别它们所违反的具体设计规则，有助于保护读者并减少虚假信息的传播。然而，由于缺乏大规模、多样化且公开可用的数据集，限制了AI模型的训练和评估。在这项工作中，我们引入了Misviz，这是一个包含2,604个真实世界可视化基准，标注了12种类型的误导因素。为了支持模型训练，我们还创建了Misviz-synth，一个包含57,665个使用Matplotlib生成并基于真实数据表的合成数据集。我们使用最先进的MLLMs、基于规则的系统和图像-坐标轴分类器对这两个数据集进行了全面评估。我们的结果表明，这项任务仍然极具挑战性。我们发布了Misviz、Misviz-synth以及配套代码。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决自动化检测误导性可视化及其设计规则违规的挑战，因为现有AI模型和人类都容易被此类图表欺骗，且缺乏大规模训练数据。为此，作者构建并发布了两个数据集：一个包含2,604个真实世界图表的基准数据集Misviz，以及一个包含57,665个合成图表的训练数据集Misviz-synth。通过使用最先进的MLLMs和传统方法对这些数据集进行评估，研究揭示了自动化检测误导性可视化的任务目前仍面临高度挑战。
AI.keywords: 误导性可视化, 虚假信息检测, 数据集, 多模态大语言模型, Misviz
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于构建并公开了两个急需的大规模、多样化的数据集（Misviz和Misviz-synth），以推动自动化检测误导性可视化的研究。这一领域对于对抗网络虚假信息至关重要。研究结果明确指出，即使是当前最先进的MLLMs，在识别图表中的微妙误导方面也存在显著局限性，为未来研究设定了一个清晰的挑战目标。数据集的规模和多样性有望成为该领域后续工作的重要基石。

title: StoxLSTM: A Stochastic Extended Long Short-Term Memory Network for Time Series Forecasting
summary: The Extended Long Short-Term Memory (xLSTM) network has demonstrated strong capability in modeling complex long-term dependencies in time series data. Despite its success, the deterministic architecture of xLSTM limits its representational capacity and forecasting performance, especially on challenging real-world time series datasets characterized by inherent uncertainty, stochasticity, and complex hierarchical latent dynamics. In this work, we propose StoxLSTM, a stochastic xLSTM within a designed state space modeling framework, which integrates latent stochastic variables directly into the recurrent units to effectively model deep latent temporal dynamics and uncertainty. The designed state space model follows an efficient non-autoregressive generative approach, achieving strong predictive performance without complex modifications to the original xLSTM architecture. Extensive experiments on publicly available benchmark datasets demonstrate that StoxLSTM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior performance and generalization.

AI.title_translation: StoxLSTM：用于时间序列预测的随机扩展长短期记忆网络
AI.tldr: 提出StoxLSTM，它是一个随机版本的xLSTM，通过将随机变量集成到递归单元中，用于有效建模时间序列数据中的不确定性和复杂动态，并在基准测试中优于现有最佳模型。
AI.motivation: 扩展长短期记忆网络（xLSTM）的确定性架构限制了其表示能力和预测性能，尤其是在处理具有固有不确定性、随机性和复杂分层潜在动态的真实世界时间序列数据集时。
AI.method: 提出StoxLSTM，它是在设计的状态空间建模框架内的随机xLSTM。它将潜在随机变量直接集成到循环单元中，以有效建模深层潜在时间动态和不确定性。该状态空间模型采用高效的非自回归生成方法。
AI.result: 在公开的基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，StoxLSTM始终优于最先进的基线模型，实现了卓越的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: StoxLSTM通过引入随机性，成功解决了确定性xLSTM在处理复杂和不确定时间序列数据时的局限性，并在性能和泛化方面表现出优越性。
AI.translation: 扩展长短期记忆（xLSTM）网络在建模时间序列数据中复杂的长期依赖性方面表现出强大的能力。尽管取得了成功，但xLSTM的确定性架构限制了其表示能力和预测性能，尤其是在处理具有固有不确定性、随机性和复杂分层潜在动态的挑战性真实世界时间序列数据集时。在这项工作中，我们提出了StoxLSTM，它是在设计的状态空间建模框架内的随机xLSTM，将潜在随机变量直接集成到循环单元中，以有效建模深层潜在时间动态和不确定性。所设计状态空间模型遵循高效的非自回归生成方法，在不复杂修改原始xLSTM架构的情况下实现了强大的预测性能。在公开的基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，StoxLSTM始终优于最先进的基线模型，实现了卓越的性能和泛化能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了StoxLSTM，这是一种在状态空间建模框架下的随机扩展长短期记忆（xLSTM）网络，旨在解决传统xLSTM在处理具有不确定性和复杂动态的时间序列数据时因确定性架构导致的性能限制。StoxLSTM通过在循环单元中集成潜在随机变量来建模深层潜在动态和不确定性，并采用高效的非自回归生成方法。实验证明，StoxLSTM在标准基准数据集上持续超越现有最先进模型，展现出卓越的预测性能和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: StoxLSTM, 时间序列预测, 随机网络, xLSTM, 状态空间模型
AI.comments: 创新点在于将随机性引入到先进的xLSTM架构中，并通过状态空间模型框架实现，以解决现实世界时间序列数据中固有的不确定性问题。这种“随机化”确定性模型的方法是提升模型在复杂、非线性、高随机性数据上表现的有效途径。特别值得注意的是，该方法声称在不大幅修改原始xLSTM架构的情况下实现了性能提升，这表明其设计具有高效性和实用性。

title: Disentangling trust from cooperation: Trust as reduced monitoring across social dilemmas
summary: It is commonly assumed that trust increases cooperation. However, game-theoretic models often fail to distinguish between cooperative actions and trust, making it difficult to independently measure trust and determine how its effects vary in different social dilemmas. To address this, we build on influential theories that equate trust with reduced monitoring of an agent's actions. We implement this as a heuristic that cognitively bounded agents can use in repeated games to avoid spending time and effort always monitoring their partner. Agents using this heuristic reduce monitoring of a partner's actions once a threshold level of cooperativeness has been observed -- providing a measurable and architecture-agnostic definition of trust. Using evolutionary game theory, we systematically analyse the success of strategies that use this trust heuristic across the entire space of two-player symmetric social dilemma games. We demonstrate that trust-as-reduced-monitoring facilitates cooperation in two different ways. First, when monitoring is costly, trust heuristics allow for higher levels of cooperation in social dilemmas where the temptation to defect is high. Second, when agents can make action errors, trust heuristics promote cooperation even in coordination problems. Our results disentangle trust from cooperation, and provide a behavioural measure of trust that applies across interaction types.

AI.title_translation: 将信任与合作分离：信任作为跨社会困境的监控减少
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可测量的、基于启发式的“信任即减少监控”定义，并在进化博弈论中分析了其效果。结果表明，在监控成本高或存在行动错误的情况下，这种信任机制能有效促进合作。
AI.motivation: 传统的博弈论模型通常未能区分合作行为和信任，导致难以独立测量信任及其在不同社会困境中的影响。
AI.method: 1. 采纳了“信任等同于减少监控”的理论，并将其实现为一种启发式（heuristic）。2. 这种启发式允许认知受限的代理人在观察到一定合作水平后减少对伙伴的监控。3. 使用进化博弈论，系统地分析了在所有双人对称社会困境博弈中，使用这种信任启发式策略的成功率。
AI.result: “信任即减少监控”通过两种方式促进合作：1. 当监控成本高时，信任启发式在有高背叛诱惑的社会困境中实现了更高水平的合作。2. 当代理人可能犯行动错误时，信任启发式甚至在协调问题中也能促进合作。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将信任与合作分离，并提供了一种适用于不同互动类型的、可测量的行为信任指标。
AI.translation: 人们通常认为信任会增加合作。然而，博弈论模型往往未能区分合作行为和信任，使得独立测量信任及其在不同社会困境中影响的确定变得困难。为解决此问题，我们基于将信任等同于减少对代理人行为监控的有影响力的理论。我们将此实现为一种启发式，认知受限的代理人可以在重复博弈中使用它，以避免花费时间和精力持续监控其伙伴。一旦观察到达到一定阈值的合作水平，使用这种启发式的代理人就会减少对伙伴行为的监控——这提供了一个可测量的、与架构无关的信任定义。我们使用进化博弈论，系统地分析了在所有双人对称社会困境博弈空间中，使用这种信任启发式策略的成功率。我们证明了“信任即减少监控”通过两种不同的方式促进合作。首先，当监控成本高昂时，信任启发式在有高背叛诱惑的社会困境中允许更高水平的合作。其次，当代理人可能犯行动错误时，信任启发式甚至在协调问题中也能促进合作。我们的结果将信任与合作分离，并提供了一种适用于各种互动类型的行为信任测量方法。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决博弈论中信任与合作混淆的问题，提出了一种基于“减少监控”的信任定义。这种信任被实现为一种认知受限代理人的启发式，即在观察到一定合作水平后减少对伙伴的监控。通过进化博弈论分析，研究发现，当监控成本高或存在行动错误时，这种信任启发式能有效促进社会困境和协调问题中的合作。最终，研究提供了一种跨互动类型的、可测量的行为信任指标。
AI.keywords: 信任, 合作, 社会困境, 减少监控, 进化博弈论
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它提供了一个明确、可操作且可测量的信任行为定义（信任=减少监控），从而解决了传统博弈论模型中信任与合作混淆的问题。通过将信任视为一种应对认知限制和监控成本的启发式，它成功地在理论上将信任从单纯的合作行动中分离出来。其重要性在于，它不仅为社会困境研究提供了一种新的分析工具，而且揭示了信任在促进合作中的具体机制，尤其是在现实世界中监控并非免费且存在不确定性（行动错误）的情况下。这种将心理学/认知限制引入进化博弈论的方法是其主要的贡献。

title: Skywork UniPic 2.0: Building Kontext Model with Online RL for Unified Multimodal Model
summary: Recent advances in multimodal models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in unified image generation and editing. However, many prominent open-source models prioritize scaling model parameters over optimizing training strategies, limiting their efficiency and performance. In this work, we present UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext, a 2B-parameter DiT model based on SD3.5-Medium, which achieves state-of-the-art image generation and editing while extending seamlessly into a unified multimodal framework. Our approach begins with architectural modifications to SD3.5-Medium and large-scale pre-training on high-quality data, enabling joint text-to-image generation and editing capabilities. To enhance instruction following and editing consistency, we propose a novel Progressive Dual-Task Reinforcement strategy (PDTR), which effectively strengthens both tasks in a staged manner. We empirically validate that the reinforcement phases for different tasks are mutually beneficial and do not induce negative interference. After pre-training and reinforcement strategies, UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext demonstrates stronger image generation and editing capabilities than models with significantly larger generation parameters-including BAGEL (7B) and Flux-Kontext (12B). Furthermore, following the MetaQuery, we connect the UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext and Qwen2.5-VL-7B via a connector and perform joint training to launch a unified multimodal model UniPic2-Metaquery. UniPic2-Metaquery integrates understanding, generation, and editing, achieving top-tier performance across diverse tasks with a simple and scalable training paradigm. This consistently validates the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed training paradigm, which we formalize as Skywork UniPic 2.0.

AI.title_translation: Skywork UniPic 2.0：使用在线强化学习构建Kontext模型以实现统一多模态模型
AI.tldr: Skywork UniPic 2.0引入了一种高效的训练范式，使用新颖的渐进式双任务强化（PDTR）策略训练了一个2B参数的模型（UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext），该模型在生成和编辑方面超越了7B和12B参数的模型。通过MetaQuery方法，它与Qwen2.5-VL-7B结合，创建了一个强大的统一多模态模型UniPic2-Metaquery，集成了理解、生成和编辑功能。
AI.motivation: 许多著名的开源多模态模型优先考虑扩展模型参数而非优化训练策略，这限制了它们的效率和性能。本文旨在通过提出优化的训练策略（Skywork UniPic 2.0）来解决这一效率和性能的瓶颈。
AI.method: 方法包括：对SD3.5-Medium进行架构修改和大规模预训练，构建2B参数的UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext模型；提出新颖的渐进式双任务强化（PDTR）策略，以分阶段方式增强指令遵循和编辑一致性；遵循MetaQuery范式，通过连接器将UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext与Qwen2.5-VL-7B连接并进行联合训练，构建统一多模态模型UniPic2-Metaquery，整合理解、生成和编辑功能。
AI.result: UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext（2B参数）展示出比参数量大得多的模型（如BAGEL 7B和Flux-Kontext 12B）更强的图像生成和编辑能力。渐进式双任务强化（PDTR）策略的强化阶段相互有益，没有负面干扰。统一多模态模型UniPic2-Metaquery在各种任务中实现了顶尖性能。
AI.conclusion: Skywork UniPic 2.0是一种有效且通用的训练范式，它通过优化训练策略和引入渐进式双任务强化（PDTR），成功构建了高效且强大的统一多模态模型UniPic2-Metaquery，该模型整合了理解、生成和编辑功能，并在多种任务中实现了顶尖性能，超越了参数量更大的现有模型。
AI.translation: 近期多模态模型的进展在统一图像生成和编辑方面展示了令人印象深刻的能力。然而，许多著名的开源模型侧重于扩展模型参数而非优化训练策略，从而限制了它们的效率和性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext，这是一个基于SD3.5-Medium的2B参数DiT模型，它在实现最先进的图像生成和编辑的同时，无缝扩展为一个统一的多模态框架。我们的方法首先对SD3.5-Medium进行架构修改，并在高质量数据上进行大规模预训练，从而实现文本到图像生成和编辑的联合能力。为了增强指令遵循和编辑一致性，我们提出了一种新颖的渐进式双任务强化（PDTR）策略，该策略以分阶段的方式有效地加强了这两个任务。我们的实验验证表明，不同任务的强化阶段相互有益，并且不会引起负面干扰。经过预训练和强化策略后，UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext展示出比参数量大得多的生成模型（包括BAGEL (7B) 和 Flux-Kontext (12B)）更强的图像生成和编辑能力。此外，我们遵循MetaQuery范式，通过连接器将UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext和Qwen2.5-VL-7B连接起来，并进行联合训练，从而推出了统一多模态模型UniPic2-Metaquery。UniPic2-Metaquery整合了理解、生成和编辑功能，通过简单且可扩展的训练范式在各种任务中实现了顶尖性能。这持续验证了我们提出的训练范式（我们将其规范化为Skywork UniPic 2.0）的有效性和通用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Skywork UniPic 2.0训练范式，旨在构建高效的统一多模态模型。核心是UniPic2-SD3.5M-Kontext，一个基于SD3.5-Medium的2B参数DiT模型，通过架构修改和新颖的渐进式双任务强化（PDTR）策略，实现了领先的图像生成和编辑能力。随后，该模型通过MetaQuery与Qwen2.5-VL-7B连接，形成了统一多模态模型UniPic2-Metaquery，成功整合了理解、生成和编辑功能，并证明了其在性能上优于参数量更大的现有模型。
AI.keywords: 统一多模态模型,强化学习,图像生成,图像编辑,Kontext模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于证明了战略性的训练优化（特别是新颖的渐进式双任务强化策略，PDTR）可以带来优于单纯扩大规模（与7B和12B模型相比）的性能和效率（2B参数）。这种方法论上的转变解决了当前许多开源模型效率低下的问题。此外，通过遵循MetaQuery范式，将生成模型与视觉语言模型（Qwen2.5-VL-7B）连接，构建统一多模态模型（UniPic2-Metaquery），展示了一个高度可扩展和通用化的框架，能够同时处理理解、生成和编辑任务。

title: Collaborate, Deliberate, Evaluate: How LLM Alignment Affects Coordinated Multi-Agent Outcomes
comments: This submission is a new version of arXiv:2509.05882v1. with a substantially revised experimental pipeline and new metrics. In particular, collaborator agents are now instantiated independently via separate API calls, rather than generated autoregressively by a single agent. All experimental results are new. Accepted as an extended abstract at AAMAS 2026
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) get integrated into diverse workflows, they are increasingly being regarded as "collaborators" with humans, and required to work in coordination with other AI systems. If such AI collaborators are to reliably coordinate their actions and behaviors with humans or other AIs, their properties and behaviors over multi-turn interactions must be known and predictable. This paper examines how different alignment methods affect LLM agents' effectiveness as partners in multi-turn, multi-party collaborations. We study this question through the lens of intervention agents that insert themselves into group dialogues not to provide answers, but to encourage the collaborative group to slow down and reflect upon their reasoning for deliberative decision-making. Common alignment techniques are typically developed under simplified single-user settings and assume the optimality of the underlying token MDP. Using the theoretical lens of the modified-action MDP, we show how they do not account for the dynamics of long-horizon multi-party interactions. We present a novel roleplay simulation methodology, where we align LLMs according to different methods and then deploy them in collaborative task dialogues to quantify how interventions affect the trajectory of group collaboration, belief alignment, and coordination. Our results show that an intervention agent that is robust to action modification significantly outperforms common alignment baselines in supporting correct task outcomes.
comment: This submission is a new version of arXiv:2509.05882v1. with a substantially revised experimental pipeline and new metrics. In particular, collaborator agents are now instantiated independently via separate API calls, rather than generated autoregressively by a single agent. All experimental results are new. Accepted as an extended abstract at AAMAS 2026

AI.title_translation: 协作、审议、评估：LLM对齐如何影响协调多智能体结果
AI.tldr: 研究了不同的LLM对齐方法如何影响多方协作中的智能体性能。结果显示，一个对动作修改具有鲁棒性的干预智能体在支持正确的任务结果方面明显优于常见的对齐基线。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被整合到多样化的工作流程中并作为“协作者”与人类或AI系统协作，需要了解和预测其在多轮交互中的属性和行为，以确保可靠的行动和行为协调。
AI.method: 1. 使用修改动作马尔可夫决策过程（modified-action MDP）的理论视角，说明传统对齐技术不考虑长周期多方交互的动态。2. 提出一种新颖的角色扮演模拟方法（roleplay simulation methodology）。3. 将LLM根据不同方法进行对齐，并将其部署在协作任务对话中。4. 量化干预如何影响群体协作轨迹、信念对齐和协调。
AI.result: 一个对动作修改具有鲁棒性的干预智能体在支持正确的任务结果方面，显著优于常见的对齐基线。
AI.conclusion: 传统的对齐技术（通常在简化的单用户设置下开发）没有考虑到长周期多方交互的动态，而一个对动作修改具有鲁棒性的干预智能体对于提高多智能体协作任务的正确结果至关重要。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）被整合到多样化的工作流程中，它们正日益被视为人类的“协作者”，并被要求与其他AI系统协调工作。如果这些AI协作者要可靠地协调其与人类或其他AI的行动和行为，那么它们在多轮交互中的属性和行为必须是已知且可预测的。本文研究了不同的对齐方法如何影响LLM智能体在多轮、多方协作中作为伙伴的有效性。我们通过干预智能体的视角来研究这个问题，这些干预智能体介入到群体对话中，目的不是提供答案，而是鼓励协作群体放慢速度并反思其推理过程以进行审议性决策。常见的对齐技术通常是在简化的单用户设置下开发的，并假设底层令牌MDP的最优性。我们使用修改动作马尔可夫决策过程（modified-action MDP）的理论视角，展示了它们如何没有考虑到长周期多方交互的动态。我们提出了一种新颖的角色扮演模拟方法，我们根据不同的方法对LLM进行对齐，然后将它们部署在协作任务对话中，以量化干预如何影响群体协作轨迹、信念对齐和协调。我们的结果显示，一个对动作修改具有鲁棒性的干预智能体在支持正确的任务结果方面，显著优于常见的对齐基线。
AI.summary: 本文研究了LLM对齐方法对多智能体协调协作结果的影响。研究采用了鼓励群体审议的干预智能体视角，并指出传统的单用户对齐技术在长周期多方交互中表现不足。通过修改动作MDP理论和角色扮演模拟，作者证明了一个对动作修改具有鲁棒性的干预智能体在提高群组任务决策的正确性方面，显著优于标准对齐方法。
AI.keywords: LLM对齐, 多智能体系统, 协作, 审议, 修改动作MDP
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将LLM的对齐问题从传统的单用户、单轮环境扩展到了复杂的多智能体协作和长周期交互场景。通过引入“干预智能体”的角色，强调了在复杂的团队决策中，促进“审议”（deliberation）和“反思”（reflection）的重要性，而不仅仅是追求即时答案。此外，使用修改动作MDP来理论化多方动态，为评估和设计多智能体系统中的对齐策略提供了更稳健的理论基础。这对于未来开发更可靠、更具社会性的AI协作系统具有重要意义。

title: Xi+: Uncertainty Supervision for Robust Speaker Embedding
summary: There are various factors that can influence the performance of speaker recognition systems, such as emotion, language and other speaker-related or context-related variations. Since individual speech frames do not contribute equally to the utterance-level representation, it is essential to estimate the importance or reliability of each frame. The xi-vector model addresses this by assigning different weights to frames based on uncertainty estimation. However, its uncertainty estimation model is implicitly trained through classification loss alone and does not consider the temporal relationships between frames, which may lead to suboptimal supervision. In this paper, we propose an improved architecture, xi+. Compared to xi-vector, xi+ incorporates a temporal attention module to capture frame-level uncertainty in a context-aware manner. In addition, we introduce a novel loss function, Stochastic Variance Loss, which explicitly supervises the learning of uncertainty. Results demonstrate consistent performance improvements of about 10\% on the VoxCeleb1-O set and 11\% on the NIST SRE 2024 evaluation set.

AI.title_translation: Xi+：用于鲁棒说话人嵌入的不确定性监督
AI.tldr: 提出Xi+模型，通过时序注意力模块和随机方差损失显式监督帧级不确定性，显著提高了说话人识别的鲁棒性，并在基准测试中获得了10%以上的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 说话人识别性能受情绪、语言和上下文等多种因素影响。由于并非所有语音帧的贡献都相等，估计每帧的可靠性至关重要。现有xi-vector模型对帧不确定性的估计是隐式的（仅通过分类损失），且未考虑帧间的时序关系，导致监督次优。
AI.method: 提出了改进的Xi+架构。该架构包含一个时序注意力模块，以上下文感知的方式捕获帧级不确定性。此外，引入了一种新的损失函数——随机方差损失（Stochastic Variance Loss），用于显式监督不确定性的学习。
AI.result: 在VoxCeleb1-O数据集上性能持续提升约10%，在NIST SRE 2024评估集上性能提升约11%。
AI.translation: 说话人识别系统的性能可能受到各种因素的影响，例如情绪、语言以及其他与说话人或上下文相关的变化。由于单个语音帧对语篇级表示的贡献不尽相同，因此估计每帧的重要性或可靠性至关重要。xi-vector模型通过基于不确定性估计为帧分配不同的权重来解决这个问题。然而，它的不确定性估计模型仅通过分类损失隐式训练，并且没有考虑帧之间的时序关系，这可能导致次优的监督。在本文中，我们提出了一种改进的架构——Xi+。与xi-vector相比，Xi+结合了一个时序注意力模块，以上下文感知的方式捕获帧级不确定性。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的损失函数——随机方差损失（Stochastic Variance Loss），用于显式监督不确定性的学习。结果表明，在VoxCeleb1-O数据集上性能持续提升约10%，在NIST SRE 2024评估集上提升约11%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Xi+模型，旨在增强说话人嵌入的鲁棒性，它是对xi-vector模型的改进。针对xi-vector不确定性估计的隐式性和缺乏上下文感知的问题，Xi+引入了时序注意力模块以捕获上下文相关的帧级不确定性，并提出了随机方差损失（Stochastic Variance Loss）以显式监督不确定性的学习。该方法在VoxCeleb1-O和NIST SRE 2024等标准基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升（10%至11%）。
AI.keywords: 不确定性监督, 说话人嵌入, 时序注意力, 随机方差损失, 说话人识别
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于两方面：一是引入时序注意力机制，使不确定性估计具备上下文感知能力，解决了原始xi-vector的关键局限，即忽略帧间的时序关系。二是提出了随机方差损失（Stochastic Variance Loss），实现了对不确定性的显式监督，超越了单纯依赖分类损失的隐式训练。这种显式学习和利用帧不确定性的方法对于构建在不同情绪、语言和上下文变化下更鲁棒的说话人识别系统至关重要。报告的性能提升（10%-11%）是显著的。

title: Competitive Audio-Language Models with Data-Efficient Single-Stage Training on Public Data
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed NLP, yet their integration with audio remains underexplored despite audio's centrality to human communication. We introduce Falcon3-Audio, a family of Audio-Language Models (ALMs) built on instruction-tuned LLMs and Whisper encoders. Using a remarkably small amount of public audio data, less than 30K hours (5K unique), Falcon3-Audio-7B matches the best reported performance among open-weight models on the MMAU benchmark, with a score of 64.14, matching R1-AQA, while distinguishing itself through superior data and parameter efficiency, single-stage training, and transparency. Notably, our smallest 1B model remains competitive with larger open models ranging from 2B to 13B parameters. Through extensive ablations, we find that common complexities such as curriculum learning, multiple audio encoders, and intricate cross-attention connectors are not required for strong performance, even compared to models trained on over 500K hours of data.

AI.title_translation: 具有数据高效单阶段训练和公共数据的竞争性音频-语言模型
AI.tldr: 引入了Falcon3-Audio，一个基于LLM和Whisper编码器的音频-语言模型（ALM）家族。它使用少于3万小时的公共数据，在MMAU基准测试上匹配了顶级开源模型的性能（64.14分），证明了无需复杂的训练策略或海量数据即可实现高效率和强大的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 尽管音频是人类交流的核心，但大型语言模型（LLMs）与音频的整合（即音频-语言模型）仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 引入了Falcon3-Audio系列模型，它基于指令调优的大型语言模型（LLM）和Whisper编码器构建。该模型采用数据高效的单阶段训练方法，仅使用了不到3万小时（5千小时独立）的公共音频数据。
AI.result: Falcon3-Audio-7B模型在MMAU基准测试中得分达到64.14，与最佳开源模型R1-AQA的性能持平。该模型在数据和参数效率、单阶段训练和透明度方面表现优越。最小的1B模型也与参数量在2B到13B范围内的更大开源模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过广泛的消融实验，本文得出结论：即使与在超过50万小时数据上训练的模型相比，获得强大的音频-语言模型性能也无需依赖课程学习、多个音频编码器或复杂的交叉注意力连接器等常见的复杂性，证明了数据和架构简化的可行性。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已经彻底改变了自然语言处理（NLP），但它们与音频的整合仍然未得到充分探索，尽管音频是人类交流的核心。我们引入了Falcon3-Audio，这是一个建立在指令调优的LLM和Whisper编码器基础上的音频-语言模型（ALMs）家族。Falcon3-Audio-7B使用极少量的公共音频数据（少于3万小时，其中独立数据5千小时），在MMAU基准测试中达到了64.14分，与R1-AQA持平，匹配了开源模型中报告的最佳性能，同时通过卓越的数据和参数效率、单阶段训练和透明度脱颖而出。值得注意的是，我们最小的1B模型与参数量从2B到13B的更大开源模型仍具有竞争力。通过广泛的消融实验，我们发现，即使与在超过50万小时数据上训练的模型相比，常见的复杂性如课程学习、多个音频编码器和复杂的交叉注意力连接器也不是获得强大性能所必需的。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Falcon3-Audio系列音频-语言模型（ALMs），它结合了指令调优的LLM和Whisper编码器。该模型创新性地采用数据高效的单阶段训练，仅使用不到3万小时的公共数据，在MMAU基准测试中实现了与现有最佳开源模型（如R1-AQA）相当的64.14分。研究强调，强大的ALM性能可以通过简化的架构实现，无需依赖复杂的训练策略或海量的训练数据，展现出卓越的效率和竞争力。
AI.keywords: 音频-语言模型, 数据高效, 单阶段训练, Falcon3-Audio, MMAU基准测试
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于证明了构建高性能音频-语言模型（ALM）并不需要海量数据和复杂的训练策略。通过使用少于3万小时的公共数据和单阶段训练，Falcon3-Audio-7B模型在关键基准测试上匹配了使用更大数据集（超过50万小时）和更复杂架构训练的顶尖开源模型的性能。这挑战了当前认为大规模数据是高性能基础的范式，为资源受限的研究者和希望提高模型透明度与效率的社区提供了重要的、更具成本效益的建模路径。此外，其最小的1B模型仍保持竞争力，显示了极高的参数效率。

title: Behind the Scenes: Mechanistic Interpretability of LoRA-adapted Whisper for Speech Emotion Recognition
summary: Large pre-trained speech models such as Whisper offer strong generalization but pose significant challenges for resource-efficient adaptation. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, yet its underlying mechanisms in speech tasks remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct the first systematic mechanistic interpretability study of LoRA within the Whisper encoder for speech emotion recognition (SER). Using a suite of analytical tools, including layer contribution probing, logit-lens inspection, and representational similarity via singular value decomposition (SVD) and centered kernel alignment (CKA), we reveal two key mechanisms: a delayed specialization process that preserves general features in early layers before consolidating task-specific information, and a forward alignment, backward differentiation dynamic between LoRA's matrices. Our findings clarify how LoRA reshapes encoder hierarchies, providing both empirical insights and a deeper mechanistic understanding for designing efficient and interpretable adaptation strategies in large speech models. Our code is available at https://github.com/harryporry77/Behind-the-Scenes.

AI.title_translation: LoRA适应的Whisper在语音情感识别中的幕后：机制可解释性研究
AI.tldr: 本文首次对用于语音情感识别（SER）的LoRA适应的Whisper编码器进行了系统的机制可解释性研究，揭示了LoRA通过“延迟专业化”和矩阵间的“前向对齐、后向分化”动态来重塑编码器层级结构，从而为设计高效、可解释的大型语音模型适应策略提供了深入理解。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练语音模型（如Whisper）的资源高效适应面临挑战。尽管LoRA是一种流行的参数高效微调方法，但其在语音任务中的潜在机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 进行了首次针对LoRA在Whisper编码器中用于语音情感识别（SER）的系统机制可解释性研究。使用了一套分析工具，包括层贡献度探测、logit-lens检查，以及通过奇异值分解（SVD）和中心核对齐（CKA）进行的表征相似性分析。
AI.result: 揭示了两种关键机制：1) 延迟专业化过程，即在整合任务特定信息之前在早期层保留通用特征；2) LoRA矩阵之间存在“前向对齐，后向分化”的动态。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现阐明了LoRA如何重塑编码器层级结构，为设计大型语音模型中高效且可解释的适应策略提供了经验性见解和更深层次的机制理解。
AI.translation: 像Whisper这样的大型预训练语音模型具有强大的泛化能力，但对资源高效的适应提出了重大挑战。低秩适应（LoRA）已成为一种流行的参数高效微调方法，但其在语音任务中的潜在机制仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们首次对LoRA在Whisper编码器中用于语音情感识别（SER）进行了系统的机制可解释性研究。我们使用一套分析工具，包括层贡献度探测、logit-lens检查，以及通过奇异值分解（SVD）和中心核对齐（CKA）进行的表征相似性分析，揭示了两种关键机制：一个延迟专业化过程，即在整合任务特定信息之前在早期层保留通用特征；以及LoRA矩阵之间存在“前向对齐，后向分化”的动态。我们的发现阐明了LoRA如何重塑编码器层级结构，为设计大型语音模型中高效且可解释的适应策略提供了经验性见解和更深层次的机制理解。我们的代码可在https://github.com/harryporry77/Behind-the-Scenes获取。
AI.summary: 本文对用于语音情感识别（SER）的LoRA适应的Whisper编码器进行了首次系统的机制可解释性研究，以解决大型语音模型高效适应机制不透明的问题。研究采用了层贡献度探测、logit-lens和表征相似性（SVD/CKA）等工具，发现LoRA通过“延迟专业化”过程（早期层保留通用特征，后期层整合任务特定信息）以及LoRA矩阵间的“前向对齐、后向分化”动态来重塑编码器层级结构，为未来设计高效且可解释的适应策略提供了机制理解。
AI.keywords: 机制可解释性, LoRA, Whisper, 语音情感识别, 参数高效微调
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次将系统的机制可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability, MI）应用于LoRA在大型语音模型（Whisper）微调中的作用，特别是在语音情感识别任务上。通过揭示“延迟专业化”和LoRA矩阵动态等关键机制，它不仅提供了关于LoRA在非文本领域如何运作的宝贵经验证据，而且为参数高效微调（PEFT）方法的设计和优化提供了理论基础，有助于推动更高效、更透明的大型模型适应策略的发展。

title: LLMs Homogenize Values in Constructive Arguments on Value-Laden Topics
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to promote prosocial and constructive discourse online. Yet little is known about how these models negotiate and shape underlying values when reframing people's arguments on value-laden topics. We conducted experiments with 465 participants from India and the United States, who wrote comments on homophobic and Islamophobic threads, and reviewed human-written and LLM-rewritten constructive versions of these comments. Our analysis shows that LLM systematically diminishes Conservative values while elevating prosocial values such as Benevolence and Universalism. When these comments were read by others, participants opposing same-sex marriage or Islam found human-written comments more aligned with their values, whereas those supportive of these communities found LLM-rewritten versions more aligned with their values. These findings suggest that value homogenization in LLM-mediated prosocial discourse runs the risk of marginalizing conservative viewpoints on value-laden topics and may inadvertently shape the dynamics of online discourse.

AI.title_translation: LLM在关于价值负载话题的建设性论证中使价值观同质化
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLM）在重写有争议话题的评论时，系统性地削弱了保守价值观并提升了亲社会价值观，导致价值观同质化。这可能疏远保守派读者，并使他们的观点被边缘化。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于促进亲社会和建设性的在线讨论，但人们对其在重构涉及价值负载话题的论点时，如何协商和塑造潜在价值观知之甚少。
AI.method: 开展了一项实验，涉及来自印度和美国的465名参与者。他们撰写了关于恐同和恐伊斯兰主题的评论，并审阅了这些评论的人工撰写和LLM重写的建设性版本。
AI.result: LLM系统性地削弱了保守价值观，同时提升了仁慈（Benevolence）和普世主义（Universalism）等亲社会价值观。反对同性婚姻或伊斯兰教的参与者认为人工撰写的评论更符合他们的价值观；支持这些群体的参与者则认为LLM重写的版本更符合他们的价值观。
AI.conclusion: LLM介导的亲社会讨论中的价值观同质化，存在边缘化保守观点的风险，并可能无意中塑造在线讨论的动态。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于促进亲社会和建设性的在线讨论。然而，关于这些模型在重构涉及价值负载话题的论点时，如何协商和塑造潜在价值观，我们知之甚少。我们对来自印度和美国的465名参与者进行了实验，他们撰写了关于恐同和恐伊斯兰主题的评论，并审阅了这些评论的人工撰写和LLM重写的建设性版本。我们的分析显示，LLM系统性地削弱了保守价值观，同时提升了仁慈和普世主义等亲社会价值观。当这些评论被其他人阅读时，反对同性婚姻或伊斯兰教的参与者认为人工撰写的评论更符合他们的价值观，而支持这些群体的参与者则认为LLM重写的版本更符合他们的价值观。这些发现表明，LLM介导的亲社会讨论中的价值观同质化，存在边缘化价值负载话题上的保守观点的风险，并可能无意中塑造在线讨论的动态。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对465名参与者的实验发现，当LLM将涉及价值负载话题（如恐同、恐伊斯兰）的评论重写为建设性版本时，它们系统性地减少了保守价值观并提升了亲社会价值观，实现了价值观同质化。这种同质化使得保守派读者更偏爱人工撰写的评论，而支持性读者更偏爱LLM版本。研究警告，这种模式可能导致保守观点被边缘化，从而影响在线讨论的生态。
AI.keywords: LLM, 价值观同质化, 建设性论证, 保守价值观, 亲社会讨论
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于直接量化了LLM在重构建设性论证过程中对内在价值观的系统性影响。其重要性在于揭示了在利用LLM促进亲社会讨论时潜在的伦理风险：模型通过价值观同质化，无意中偏向了亲社会/自由主义价值观，从而可能压制或边缘化在线讨论中具有重要社会意义的保守观点，这对数字治理和平台设计具有关键的警示作用。

title: No Mesh, No Problem: Estimating Coral Volume and Surface from Sparse Multi-View Images
comments: Reverted to previous version due to clarity issues
summary: Effective reef monitoring requires the quantification of coral growth via accurate volumetric and surface area estimates, which is a challenging task due to the complex morphology of corals. We propose a novel, lightweight, and scalable learning framework that addresses this challenge by predicting the 3D volume and surface area of coral-like objects from 2D multi-view RGB images. Our approach utilizes a pre-trained module (VGGT) to extract dense point maps from each view; these maps are merged into a unified point cloud and enriched with per-view confidence scores. The resulting cloud is fed to two parallel DGCNN decoder heads, which jointly output the volume and the surface area of the coral, as well as their corresponding confidence estimate. To enhance prediction stability and provide uncertainty estimates, we introduce a composite loss function based on Gaussian negative log-likelihood in both real and log domains. Our method achieves competitive accuracy and generalizes well to unseen morphologies. This framework paves the way for efficient and scalable coral geometry estimation directly from a sparse set of images, with potential applications in coral growth analysis and reef monitoring.
